label: Change in district HDI, 2005-2015
definition: Change in the district HDI, 2005 to 2015
publisher: UNDP Pakistan, National Human Development Report 2017
latest_available_wave: unconfirmed: UNDP NHDR 2020 (Inequality) is said to present district HDI, not verified
currency_note: UNDP pages returned 403 to the fetcher, so whether NHDR 2020 carries a district HDI comparable with the 2005-2015 series could not be confirmed. Related lead: the MPI Report 2019-20 (2024) gives district MPI change 2014-15 to 2019-20 for 110 districts (https://ophi.org.uk/sites/default/files/2025-01/Pakistan_MPI_2019%E2%80%9320_%282024%29.pdf), PDF only.
